sources.observed: Night facade photo inspected: cream stucco, projecting red/cream striped metal canopy, bright red roof-edge strip and TACOS MEXICO letters, paired rectangular framed windows with red perimeter lighting and low trimmed hedge. Google map address1800SLasVegasBlvd.

Drive-through parking pano shows narrow east end: three framed tall rectangular windows, red/white striped projecting hood with red letters above, white piers/red base trim, broad drive lane north and parking south. Older view corroborates structural form in2026photo; no current-condition assertion from2018 alone.

Southern parking-side full facade: long low wall with tall pilasters, continuous red/white striped hood, roof stepped up central section and eastern sign bay; windows concentrated at eastern dining end. Separate red roadside pylon at southwest.

remaining: Exact logo crest, window menu graphics and lighting unfinished
Sign proportions and detailed awning corner folds need further refinement
Planting and precise parking/curb extent not yet matched
